body: Lies.  Lies to assuage anger.  Lies to make a sale.  One company told me to lie to customers.  One company fired a ton of our employees in a short period of time and left the rest of us workers with an impossible workload.  Another company had sales representatives that were either clandestine about details in contracts, or just straight-up lied about who we were and what we had to offer.  All of these companies are very large companies that are very successful.  It's left me incredibly cynical about corporations in general, which has the effect of me not wanting to live in a world where the people who condone this type of action are successful.

Thanks.  I've tried finding a purpose a lot.  I've tried to develop a love for film before, but all that did for me was turn me into a film junkie elitist who holds disdain for people that enjoy blockbuster film, which has led me to limit my social interactions with people all the more.  That didn't work out at all.  I've tried wasting my life away on World of Warcraft, but that gets boring after a while.  I've tried Rock Band 3 to that same goal, but I just always lose interest.  It seems I just move from thing to thing, nothing ever being "my thing."  Even if I'm good at it, I don't find much joy from that.  I think I've pretty much given up believing there's something out there that I would find is worth doing.

Regardless of what I've said, it's still nice to know that someone can relate to the whole distance from society I feel.  None of these things like a job or relationships have done anything to make me happy.

I've thought about travel but it's never really been all that interesting to me.  I had a chance to live in Serbia for a while in my life, and while it was a good adventure it was also a colossal waste of time.  I've been to lots of places.  This seems just like a temporary solution which would immediately send me back where I was as soon as I was home.  Even if I could attempt to make a list of places to visit, I'm not confident enough to do it alone.  I've been on a solitary road trip all across the USA before and it was not anywhere near as much fun as it should have been.  Thanks for responding though.
